page: Microsoft Azure DC16eds_v6 is a general purpose virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor featuring 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance lacks discrete GPU acceleration and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

For high-speed I/O requirements, the instance provides 944 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. This integrated local NVMe capacity delivers low latency and fast scratch space without relying solely on remote disks, balancing compute throughput with responsive local disk operations.

Because standard benchmark records are not available for this profile, evaluation relies on its dedicated hardware parameters. The combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, 64.0 GB of RAM, and fast local NVMe storage establishes strong baseline efficiency for enterprise workloads that need consistent compute and rapid local data caching, such as relational databases, analytics tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and application backends.
